newsitem.title: USA: New Jersey court gives more time on school reform.
newsitem.headline: New Jersey court gives more time on school reform.

text.p: The state Supreme Court Tuesday gave Governor Christie Whitman and the state Legislature a three-month extension to draft a final school funding plan to satisfy its 1994 order to make it more equitable to poor, urban districts.

The order rejected an attempt by lawyers to compel the state to increase funding immediately for the 30 districts identified in that 1994 ruling as having "special needs." Six justices unanimously took "judicial notice that the Legislature is actively considering legislation to address its obligations."
